fact: A 2026 Ministry of Interior and UM6P presentation says the ministry contracts the university's MOSIP Centre of Excellence for L3 support and for evolution of the MOSIP and RNP code, citing a drive for technological autonomy and less external dependence, with the RNP generalised to all 83 provinces in October 2022.
title: Collaborations between Governments and Academic Institutions to Build Capacity and Provide L3 Support
publisher: Ministère de l'Intérieur, Royaume du Maroc / UM6P (MOSIP Connect)
